name: First Shift
summary: A pocket-guide identity that helps a new volunteer move from arrival to useful action with clear cues and a route to help.

typography.usage: Short route and stage labels, with enough tracking to read at pocket size.
Volunteer actions, help details and practical notes.

recognitionRules: Use DIN Condensed for short stage headings and Noto Sans for instructions.
Organize the guide around the actual sequence of arrival and work.
Keep contact or help information separate and easy to find.
Use sage route panels with green left rails, underlined numbered stage names and right-aligned page numbers; keep instructions in dark green ink.

principles: Make the invitation warm and the practical details exact.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Arrive. Find your person. Know the next useful thing to do.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid speaking for an entire community or implying confirmed attendance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Come for the part that interests you; here is what to expect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use FIRST SHIFT in DIN Condensed with a small Noto Sans guide label and one vertical route rule. No helping-hands symbol.
invariants: Use DIN Condensed for short stage headings and Noto Sans for instructions.
Organize the guide around the actual sequence of arrival and work.
Keep contact or help information separate and easy to find.
adaptations: A pocket fold keeps the help panel visible when closed.
A digital version uses the same stage names as the printed guide.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: DIN Condensed is a separately licensed commercial font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
